resources.string: Automatically start embedded service when opening the app

Off by default. When opening the app, try to connect and start the embedded service using existing wireless debugging pairing. Requires available wireless debugging and the necessary permissions. Does not automatically pair again or use root.
After startup, the automatic application switch on the home screen controls whether saved configurations are applied.
Startup conditions will be checked when you next open the app.
The embedded service is ready. No further startup is needed.
Skipped this attempt because another operation was active. Use a manual option or reopen the app to try again.
Operation verification is required. Complete it first; automatic startup cannot bypass this state.
Automatic startup is unavailable: allow app notifications and enable the wireless startup notification channel.
Automatic startup is unavailable: allow local network access.
Automatic startup is unavailable: existing pairing credentials could not be read. Complete wireless debugging pairing manually first.
Automatic startup failed this time. Check wireless debugging availability or use a manual option.
Automatic startup was cancelled. No automatic retry was made.
Automatic startup is unavailable in the current state. Check backend status or use a manual option.
